definitions: To enter a place or building.
To arrive, especially at a destination or as part of a delivery.
To be received, especially money or information.
To finish in a particular position in a race or competition.
examples: She came in through the back door.
The new shipment of books came in this morning.
That style of dress came in last season.
A lot of complaints came in after the announcement.
He came in first in the marathon.
